item.title: 2 pedestrians critically injured in separate Indianapolis crashes
item.description: Two pedestrians were hit by vehicles and taken to a hospital in critical condition in two separate accidents that occurred less than two miles apart in Indianapolis on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Judge orders Trump to end California National Guard troop deployment in Los Angeles
item.description: (AP) — The Trump administration must stop deploying the California National Guard in Los Angeles and return control of the troops to the state, a federal judge ordered Wednesday in an emphatic ruling. item.title: Gary Police Department officer arrested for domestic violence, OWI
item.description: GARY, Ind. (WISH) — An officer with the Gary Police Department has been arrested for domestic violence and operating a vehicle while intoxicated. On Tuesday, the Gary Police Department was notified of the arrest of Sergeant Jamaal Joseph, a 17-year veteran of the Gary Police Department, by the Portage Police Department. item.title: Margins slim ahead of final redistricting vote
item.description: Indiana lawmakers are set to vote on Thursday on a bill that would redraw the state's U.S. House district maps. All signs point to a close vote.

item.title: Lawmakers consider restrictions on medical debt collections
item.description: A Senate panel discussed legislation that would limit debt collectors from taking more than 10% of a person's paycheck as wage garnishment for medical debt, and require hospitals to offer a payment plan to patients making less than 400% of the federal poverty level.

item.title: Prospective citizens turned away at naturalization ceremony in Indianapolis
item.description: Marion County Clerk Kate Sweeney Bell condemned the turning away of prospective citizens based on their national origin at a naturalization ceremony in Indianapolis, calling for the federal government to reverse the policy and reschedule the ceremonies.
